summary: Frontend-only testing of the 3 new features (Unsaved Changes Badge, Reset-to-Blank, Google Drive wiring) plus regression. 100% pass. ZERO /api/ requests across entire session. All data-testid selectors present and wired correctly. Live budgetly:meta CustomEvent updates the sidebar chip + nav-backup-dot without a page reload. Reset-to-Blank confirms, wipes DB and reloads to $0.00 dashboard & empty transactions; Load-sample afterwards repopulates 352 txns. Google Drive card: empty Client ID triggers the exact validation toast ('Enter and save your Google OAuth Client ID first.'); Client ID persists in IndexedDB settings across a full reload; clicking Save-to-Drive loads https://accounts.google.com/gsi/client and makes window.google.accounts available (OAuth popup not completed — expected, no test Google account).
critical_code_review_comments: gdrive.js uses prompt:'' for requestAccessToken — if the user has never consented in this browser, GIS will silently fail with no consent UI. Consider removing the empty prompt or falling back to prompt:'consent' on first use so the user gets a visible popup. Minor UX.

Backup.js saveToDrive relies on the latest-saved clientId in state (not re-read from settings before upload) — fine today, but typing a new Client ID and clicking Save-to-Drive WITHOUT clicking Save first will still attempt upload with the un-persisted value. Not a bug, but could be clarified.

resetToBlank() patches meta with dirty:false then forces window.location.reload — if the page is reloaded before the IDB transaction commits (very unlikely given the 900ms setTimeout) you could lose the clean flag. Current timing is safe.
seed_data_creation: Used Load-sample-btn to seed 352 txns; cleared via Reset-to-blank and re-seeded for regression.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified selectors: backup-status (sidebar chip), nav-backup-dot (amber dot on Backup & Restore nav item, only visible when meta.dirty=true), download-backup-btn, load-sample-btn, reset-blank-btn, drive-client-id-input, save-client-id-btn, drive-upload-btn, restore-file-input (hidden — use set_input_files). The chip updates live via window event 'budgetly:meta' dispatched from db.patchMeta — no reload needed. settings.google_client_id is persisted via api.put('/settings',...) through the local IndexedDB api wrapper, so it survives full reload. DO NOT attempt a real Google OAuth flow — just verify the GIS script loads from accounts.google.com/gsi/client and window.google.accounts becomes defined.
